businesses.business: Clinic management, healthcare and wellness services

offering_description.value: The group provides management support to clinics across aesthetic medicine and other medical specialties. It also serves patients through a clinic network and offers aesthetic dermatology and salon services in Singapore.

quotes.quote: SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. provides comprehensive management support to clinics across a wide range of medical fields, including aesthetic medicine, dermatology,dentistry, hair loss treatment, fertility treatment, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and regenerative medicine. Through an extensive network of clinics both in Japan and abroad, we are committed to delivering high-quality medical services while supporting the sustainable growth of healthcare institutions.

quotes.quote: SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. provides comprehensive management support to clinics across a wide range of medical fields, including aesthetic medicine, dermatology,dentistry, hair loss treatment, fertility treatment, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and regenerative medicine. Through an extensive network of clinics both in Japan and abroad, we are committed to delivering high-quality medical services while supporting the sustainable growth of healthcare institutions.

25 years after opening our clinic Fujisawa city, we remain captivated by the limitless possibilities of aesthetic medicine. When we began, many people were interested in aesthetic medicine but found it difficult to get started. However, as times have changed, more and more people now visit our clinic with the pure desire to "live authentically and positively". Aesthetic medicine is no longer something special or out of reach. Instead, it has become one of the choices that enriches our daily lives. SBC Medical Group is proud to have helped shape this perspective across society. Building on the expertise we have cultivated in medical services, we are expanding our knowledge and offerings beyond aesthetic medicine. By incorporating general medical care, we aim to contribute to even more people’s well-being. we became a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ in the United States. This milestone represents a significant step forward in our commitment to earning and maintaining the trust of our valued customers. First, we strive to bring smiles to our customers, helping them embrace each day with confidence and positivity. Finally, we seek to contribute to society by leveraging the power of medicine to create new value and drive sustainable progress. Moving forward, we will continue to take on new challenges to bring light to as many hearts as possible through the power of medicine. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and trust in our mission.
